status.summary: Cologix's JAX2 page, in its version modified on 22 September 2026, gives the facility address as 4800 Spring Park Road, Jacksonville, and states that 'Our JAX2 data center is in a hurricane-rated building housing the leading enterprise-grade data center and disaster recovery facility in Jacksonville' and that customers choose JAX2 for its power density, redundancy and disaster-recovery integration; it lists a 125K SQFT facility with 24/7 building and suite guards onsite, a Cologix-controlled meet-me room with 8+ networks and EPA ENERGY STAR certification, and this version adds 'Site capacity: 3 MW'. This records JAX2 as operating on 22 September 2026, the modification day of the captured version (bounded by the Internet Archive copy of 30 June 2026 and the live capture of 23 October 2026); it is not an opening date. The 3 MW site capacity is not load in service, and occupancy is not established.

locator.precision: Planar centroid of Duval County parcel 1530840120R (4.82 geodesic acres, about 191 by 227 m) in the Florida Department of Revenue statewide cadastral compilation, the 2026-roll parcel for 4800 Spring Park Road carrying one 121,784 sq ft building. It locates the data-centre property, not the building footprint, a surveyed position or the extent of data-centre space.
locator.identity_review: Cologix's JAX2 page names 4800 Spring Park Road, Jacksonville, Florida, and a 125K SQFT facility in a hurricane-rated building. The statewide cadastral layer has two parcels with that physical address: 1530840120R (land 209,808 sq ft, one building of 121,784 sq ft built 1971, DOR use code 091) and 1530840105R (553 sq ft, no building). The building on 1530840120R matches the operator's floor area within 3 percent, so it is selected; the 553 sq ft parcel cannot hold the facility and is excluded. The roll's owner is an organisation and is not used as a role claim. No geocoder, map viewport, city centre or industrial-area centroid is used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The statewide compilation publishes no positional accuracy for county parcel polygons; the centroid represents a 4.8-acre parcel about 191 by 227 m, and the position of the data-centre space within the building is not published.

additions.name: QTS Suwanee campus — existing data-centre campus operations (DC1 and DC2)

status.summary: QTS's Suwanee 1 page, in its version modified on 2 October 2026, states that 'QTS's Suwanee, Georgia data center campus is home to some of our largest customers with 100+ MW current planned critical campus capacity in the north suburbs of Atlanta', lists 50+ MW critical campus capacity, a dedicated on-site substation, customer amenities and the QTS Operations Support Center, and maps DC1 at 300 Satellite Blvd NW and DC2 at 120 Satellite Blvd NW. QTS's Fayetteville page (version of 19 August 2026) says QTS operates the Suwanee campus, 'since 2005'. This records the campus as operating on 2 October 2026, the modification day of the captured Suwanee version (bounded by the Internet Archive copy of 21 September 2026 and the live capture of 23 October 2026); it is not an opening date. Which halls or buildings are in service is not stated separately, and the capacities are campus figures, not load in service.

locator.precision: Planar centroid of the union of Gwinnett County parcels 7194 029 (300 Satellite Blvd) and 7194 180 (120 Satellite Blvd), which adjoin (one part, 39.50 geodesic acres, about 796 by 553 m). It locates the two-parcel campus carrying QTS's DC1 and DC2, not either building footprint, an entrance or a surveyed boundary. QTS states a 53-acre campus, larger than these two parcels: an adjoining 15.37-acre parcel, PIN 7169 197 (3224 Wanstead Park Dr, property class 300 Commercial Vacant Land, owner Quality Investment Properties Gateway LLC, a QTS-named organisation), shares a boundary with the union; it is classed as vacant land and is not part of this locator.
locator.identity_review: QTS's Suwanee 1 page gives DC1 at 300 Satellite Blvd NW and DC2 at 120 Satellite Blvd NW, Suwanee, and the Operations Support Center at 300 Satellite Boulevard. The county tax master table has exactly one record for each address: PIN 7194 029 ('300 SATELLITE BLVD STE 204', owner Quality Inv Properties Suwanee LLC) and PIN 7194 180 ('120 SATELLITE BLVD', owner QTS Suwanee I DC2 LLC), both zoned M1 and both in property class 391, 'Data Center'. The two parcels share a boundary, and the union centroid lies inside the union between the parcel centroids (401 m apart). No geocoder, map viewport or city centre is used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Gwinnett County publishes no positional accuracy for its parcel polygons; the centroid represents a 39.5-acre two-parcel campus about 796 by 553 m and does not distinguish DC1 from DC2. If the operator's 53-acre campus includes the adjoining vacant parcel 7169 197, the three-parcel centroid (54.7 geodesic acres) lies about 48 m south-south-east of this point, still inside the two-parcel union (verifier check, 23 October 2026: local verifier1-gwinnett-parcels-7169-197-7194-029-7194-180-wgs84.json and verifier1-gwinnett-taxtable-owner-qts-quality-inv.json).
